| [`animations/font-palette-animation-not-specified-endpoints.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/css/css-fonts/animations/font-palette-animation-not-specified-endpoints.html) | Fail | 1 / 2 | TEST BUG | the last subtest runs `@keyframes animFrom { from { font-palette: --custom } }` with `animation-fill-mode: forwards` on an element whose `style` attribute sets `font-palette: --custom`, and expects `normal` at the end of the animation: the neutral `to` keyframe is the underlying value (https://drafts.csswg.org/css-animations-1/#keyframes), `--custom`, so the animated value is `--custom`, as in Firefox and Safari (only Chrome returns `normal`) |
